svg.desc: Three attempts left to right: a timeout, a 503, then success, separated by waits that double with jitter. Below, a 422 validation error is never retried, and only idempotent calls are safe to retry.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Time out, retry what might not repeat, back off with jitter. Never retry a validation error.
